diagnosis.summary: The IR specifies a repeating cycle with a 3-minute period. The candidate script is one-shot (period=0) and terminates after the first execution, missing all subsequent cycles. Evidence F2 shows the IR emitting an action at 190000ms (within the first cycle), but the candidate has already terminated or is not set up to repeat.
diagnosis.change_summary: Changed `period` from 0 to 180000 (3 MIN) to enable repetition. Restructured the script to remove the final `delay(3 MIN)` (which was the cycle period in the IR) and instead place the actions inside the repeating body, ensuring the cycle fires every 3 minutes as specified.
